This site hosts the supporting documentation for the research project
*Troublesome Technologies and Learning Trajectories in Digital
Preservation Practice*, conducted by {{< var researcher.name >}} and
{{< var pi.name >}}, {{< var school >}}, {{< var university >}}. The
study has been classified as a low-risk study, {{< var ethics.body >}},
approved by the {{< var ethics.ref >}}.

This research explores how digital preservation practitioners experience
and navigate learning challenges throughout their professional
trajectories. In particular, it seeks to understand what makes
particular digital technologies troublesome to learn, how practitioners
respond to these difficulties, what strategies and workarounds they
develop, and which sources of knowledge and support they draw upon as
they build competence.

Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY
4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

> Osti, G., & Cushing, A. (2026). *Troublesome Technologies and Learning
> Trajectories in Digital Preservation Practice* (Version 1.0)
> \[Research materials\]. University College Dublin.
> <https://semanticnoodles.github.io/troublesome-technologies/>
